dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical narrowing from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle, ending in a distinct point.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are smooth and symmetrical with no visible bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to off-white median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Diffuse, low-frequency grey mottling concentrated along the central and lower mid-dorsal regions.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; smooth transitions between the light-grey baseline and slightly darker pigmented patches.
